g.text: The three-election-mean PLS component separates recurring tract profiles

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: The map shows standardized component scores; the loading plot defines the two sides without treating either profile as intrinsically better.
Notes: Scores are standardized across 585 tracts for display. Bars are saved PLS component-1 loadings; point size is saved VIP.
Loading signs describe relative component sides and are not causal effects.
Sources: final meeting-PLS CT scores and model definitions; canonical 2021 CT geometry; City of Toronto ward geometry.
